Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the task and selected option B, mischaracterizing Earth’s long-term surface evolution. Over billions of years, mountains are worn down while new ones are continually formed by plate tectonics; thus option C is correct. The Planner overlooked this ongoing orogenic-erosional cycle and did not engage any specialist despite the instruction to do so.
